newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cen. bank sees 1996 inflation below target.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cen. bank sees 1996 inflation below target.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday it expected the country's annual inflation rate to dip below it's targetted range of 6.0-7.2 percent year-on-year.

"Based on recent inflation results, it is possible to assume that the annual inflation rate will be lower this year than the NBS's target of 6.0-7.2 percent," the NBS said in a statement. The statement gave no further details.
The annual inflation rate at the end of August stood at 6.0 percent, while the year-end 1995 figure was 9.9 percent.
